N17 (assignment-value cascade, found by /roslyn-n16 by hand; generator shapes from release-7.1): on the Roslyn side a moved `!Copy` view keeps its borrow and an overwritten view's old borrows still count, so the Analyzer and Stage-0 add VIB003 to the use of a moved source ({VIB001, VIB003}; self {VIB001}) and reject with VIB003 a view reassigned in a loop by a plain move, a call or an assignment value, which self accepts. Decided (A+): self is right; fix: roslyn-assign-value-cascade. Fixed in candidate 6 pre9 (kept as a regression detector)

N19 (P0, self V5; found by /self-fix, generator shapes from release-7.1): in a switch statement over `Option<T>`/`Result<T, E>`, vib-self silently drops every case label that is not a union case (`Some/None/Ok/Err(..)`), `_`/default or a designation-free `var`/type pattern: `case not NoneType when ..:`, `case Some<T> or NoneType when ..:`, `case not Err<int>:`, `case not Some<T>:`, `case var w when ..:`. Managed and Stage-0 agree; self native prints another value, panics ("index out of bounds", exit 101, when an exhaustive switch reaches its `unreachable` block) or loops. Fix: self-fix-v (V5). Candidate 6 pre9 (self-fix-v) fixes the wrong values, panics and loops; a residual of the static predicates stays open: self reports a false VIB001 on a later use of an owned `!Copy` `Option`/`Result` place after a switch statement whose labels are all whole-union labels plus `default:` (corpus/probes/union-switch r01-r12). Fixed in candidate 6 pre13 (self-fix-w removed the residual); kept as a regression detector

N19 through the self checker: self rejects a valid switch over `Option`/`Result` with a whole-union label or arm that Stage-0 and the Analyzer accept: a guarded or final `var w` (self VIB000/VIB001 with CS0165/CS0170 on its own lowering), and in switch expressions a whole-union arm (`not NoneType when ..`, `Some<T> or NoneType when ..`) before the payload arm (self VIB001: the arm moved the payload) or on a place (`o switch { not Some<T> => .. }`, self VIB005). Fix: self-fix-v (V5)
N19 when another scenario makes Stage-0 reject too: self adds VIB000/VIB001/VIB005 on a switch over `Option`/`Result` with a whole-union label or arm

N20 (fixed in candidate 6 pre13 by roslyn-linear-switch and self-fix; decided 2026-11-18 as a ban, narrowed the same day): in a switch statement or expression over a LINEAR union with an rvalue or `Move(o)` scrutinee, an arm that tests a variant (`Some<R>(...)`, `NoneType`, `Ok<R>(...)`, `Err<E>(...)`) may not carry a `when` guard, a variant may be tested by at most one arm, and `not`/`or` patterns are not allowed: each is exactly {VIB006} on all three frontends (`var u` over the whole union and a guarded discard arm stay valid; a place scrutinee keeps what all three report). On candidate 6 pre9 the Analyzer and Stage-0 add VIB001 "Use of moved value 'temporary value'" at the scrutinee, and self accepts the guarded and repeated-variant forms (it gives {VIB006} for the `not` forms). Fixes: roslyn-linear-switch (drops the extra VIB001) and self-fix (rejects the guarded and repeated-variant forms). The matrix rows `decided.linear-switch-*` (exact {VIB006}) name this root, so with it fixed a violation is a plain violation; the generator emits linear payloads only in the allowed forms (exec controls); probes in corpus/probes/linear-switch
N20 when self rejects too: Stage-0 adds VIB001 ('temporary value') to the decided VIB006, self gives {VIB006}
